newsitem.title: EGYPT: Israeli Arab dies in Egypt bus accident.
newsitem.headline: Israeli Arab dies in Egypt bus accident.

text.p: An Israeli Arab woman died and 10 members of her extended family were injured when the tour bus they were in overturned after a tyre exploded near the eastern province of Ismailia on Monday, security sources said.

They said Oreiba Mahmoud Jebara, 30, died of internal bleeding. Seventeen other people were with her on the bus, travelling with three other buses to Cairo from the town of Rafah on the border between Egypt and the Palestinian self-rule areas, they added.
An Interior Ministry statement said the accident took place in Abu Orooq area in Qantara Sharq town east of the Suez Canal.
Police in Ismailia filed a report and the prosecutor's office will follow it up, the ministry said.

A police convoy was travelling with the buses. This has been a routine procedure with tourist buses that travel long distances throughout Egypt since Moslem militants began to target tourists in the early 1990s.
